remarks: Welcome to Allendale! This brand-new, beautifully designed two-storey home showcases modern finishes and a functional layout perfect for today's lifestyle. The main floor features a spacious and inviting living area, a versatile bedroom, and a full bathroom, ideal for guests or extended family. Enjoy 9-foot ceilings on the main floor, with an additional 9-foot ceiling in the basement. Upstairs, you'll find three generously sized bedrooms, including a spacious primary bedroom complete with a walk-in closet, along with a convenient upper-floor laundry room and a versatile bonus room, perfect for family entertainment or a relaxing retreat. Vinyl plank flooring runs throughout the home, offering a stylish, carpet-free living experience. Complete with a rear deck and double detached garage, this home is ideally situated directly across from a school and baseball field in the desirable community of Allendale. Enjoy convenient access to the U of A , Whyte Avenue, shopping, restaurants, and major amenities. (id:67522)
